title: A vaccine trial
intro:
Illustrative data, made up for this book. In a randomised, placebo-controlled trial, 3,000 volunteers were assigned at random, 1,500 to the vaccine and 1,500 to a placebo. Over the season, 30 in the vaccine group and 50 in the placebo group caught the infection.

Test H₀: the infection rates are equal (two-sided, α = 0.05). Give the z statistic and the p-value (each to four decimals), and the 95 % interval for p_vaccine − p_placebo (four decimals).

In the Workbench: **Two-sample test**, **Test** *Two proportions*, **Data from** *Summary statistics entered here*, group 1 = the vaccine.
hints: The test uses the pooled p̂; the interval uses the two rates separately (item 10.5).
